description: Leading the Research and Technology division of the Informatics Student Association.
Coordinating technical workshops, seminars, and internal innovation projects for students.
Managing division members and aligning technological initiatives with organizational goals.
Developing and managing 'Arbhita', a platform initiated for the Program Kreativitas Mahasiswa (PKM) 2025.
Focusing on innovative solutions and technical implementation of the project requirements.
Assisting lecturers in conducting laboratory sessions and grading assignments for various technical courses.
Providing guidance and tutoring to students in: Keamanan Jaringan (Network Security), Jaringan Komputer (Computer Networks), and Web Desain (Web Design)
